messages.author: 53dbab5845ace6b6
messages.subject: permanent server objects?
parts:
Hi again,

Is it possible to create some kind of permanent server objects, so that changes on the UI inputs can be stored / monitored from one change to another?

For my previous question, the answer was to check if input$goButton == 0
but that only works for the "first" press of the action button.

It would be nice to store it's value somewhere on the server, then simply check if the new value is greater then what's stored (that way I will know that the action button was pressed <again> rather than first time.

Alternatively, I've tried to "store" the value in a numeric input on the web page itself, using updateNumericInput() but that action seems to trigger the server side a second time, when the "stored" value equals the action button value, and my output is re-written again.

Best,
Adrian
